hero.heading: Volunteer with Us
hero.subtitle: Support the clinical sanctuary. We offer various opportunities for advocates, administrators, and survivors to contribute their skills toward our collective healing mission.

rolesSection.heading: Open Volunteer Roles
rolesSection.description: Volunteering with a trauma-recovery initiative requires dedication to safety and confidentiality. We have structured roles depending on your experience and clinical background:

roles.title: Peer Group Assistant
roles.description: Support our registered psychotherapists during online peer facilitation groups. Requires a background in social care, mental health counseling, or peer group training.

roles.title: Administrative Aid
roles.description: Help coordinate session logs, verify donations, manage newsletter distributions, and handle logistics for public outreach campaigns.

roles.title: Tech & Security Volunteer
roles.description: Maintain our website, support encrypted portal integrations, and advise on secure database setups for maximum patient anonymity.

roles.title: Social Media Outreach Support
roles.description: Draft content, run educational social campaigns, and distribute info packets to clinics, spiritual centers, and survivor organizations.

safeguarding.heading: Safeguarding & Training
safeguarding.description: To protect the safety of our community, all volunteers working near clinical materials or interacting with survivors must undergo comprehensive identity checks, references, and a specialized training workshop regarding boundaries and cultic trauma dynamics.

otherWaysSection.heading: Other Ways to Support the Sanctuary

ways.title: Forum Monitoring
ways.description: Help maintain the safety and integrity of our Community Forum by monitoring threads for distress signals, moderating tone, and flagging posts that may require clinical attention. This role requires empathy, discretion, and adherence to our community safeguarding guidelines.

ways.title: Art & Creative Contributions
ways.description: Art, poetry, illustration, and creative writing have long been healing tools. We welcome contributions from survivors and supporters who wish to offer creative work for our resource library, community spaces, or fundraising materials. All contributions are shared with your permission and attributed as you prefer.

ways.title: Event Assistance
ways.description: Support the coordination of community awareness events, fundraising gatherings, and online webinars. This includes logistics, promotion, technical setup for virtual events, and participant communication. A meaningful way to contribute without clinical involvement.

cpdPlacement.heading: Excellent CPD & Work Experience for the Mental Health Field
paragraphs: Heal Gurukuli is led by Caitanya Lila, a UKCP-Registered Psychotherapist and the initiative’s clinical founder. This means that volunteering here is not only meaningful — it is formally valuable for anyone building a career in counselling, psychotherapy, psychology, or social work.

Our environment provides direct exposure to trauma-informed clinical practice, safeguarding frameworks, multi-disciplinary team dynamics, and the ethical standards required by the UKCP and BACP. Volunteers working in supported roles can reference this placement directly on their CV and in applications to training programmes.

For students on placement programmes, we can provide formal written references from the clinical lead, as well as structured reflection opportunities to support your professional development portfolio. We particularly welcome trainee counsellors, psychology graduates, and MSc psychotherapy students.

highlights.title: UKCP-Supervised Environment
highlights.description: All clinical practice is overseen by a registered UKCP practitioner

highlights.title: Formal References Available
highlights.description: Written professional references provided by the clinical lead on request

highlights.title: BACP-Aligned Standards
highlights.description: Work experience that aligns with counselling and psychotherapy training requirements
